name: Restaurant Guy Savoy
address: Caesars Palace, 3570 Las Vegas Blvd. S., Las Vegas, 89109
changeNote: One star in the first Las Vegas guide since 2009
dinnerNote: Prelude tasting menu, 8 courses (à la carte mains $160–$170)

menus.name: Symphony tasting menu
menus.note: $1,000 with the premium wine pairing and a glass of L'Héraud Cognac; on OpenTable it is offered 18 to 21 November 2026, hosted by Guy Savoy

menus.name: Krug Chef's Table menu
menus.note: One seating a night for 2 to 6 guests, with a glass of tête de cuvée Champagne; booked on OpenTable or by email

bookingOpens: Online on OpenTable or by phone. Dinner Tuesday to Saturday, 5pm to 8:45pm.
cancellation: A deposit is taken when booking. Changes or cancellations up to 24 hours before are refunded in full; later changes, cancellations and no-shows lose the deposit. A Krug Chef's Table booking cannot be moved: changing the date cancels it, with a $150 per person charge.
groups: Parties of six or more have the whole table on the same menu (the Forbes Five-Star Celebration menu or the Prestige menu). Groups of 13 or more call +1 866 733 5827 or use the inquiry form. Two semi-private rooms seat 16 and 18 guests and the private dining room 35.
dressCode: Business attire. No hats, flip-flops, shorts or T-shirts.
children: Children under five are not allowed.
byob: No outside food, wine or other drinks.
